title: Positions that also hold a second job with the same employer
question: How often does a San Francisco payroll row say the holder also worked a second position for the same employer, and what are those rows paid?
finding: 12,376 rows from 2019 to 2025 name another position. The commonest: San Francisco, Special Nurse: 7,273 rows; San Francisco Unified School District, Interschool Athletics: 374 rows; San Francisco Unified School District, Sped Ia Sh -All Impair: 276 rows; San Francisco Unified School District, Summer Session Teacher: 252 rows. City rows that also list Special Nurse: 7,273; the largest total wages among them: Registered Nurse (2023) $590,692.
how: State Controller raw export, column “other positions”. Counts and sums are of rows; the wages shown are the row’s total wages.
limits: A second position with the same employer is common in hospitals (a staff nurse taking extra per-diem shifts) and schools (coaching, summer school). The export does not say how the hours of the two jobs fit together.
